after.label: Actual receivers capable of acknowledgement
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual count of receivers capable of acknowledging unknown. Zero is valid as an observed incomplete network, never successful communication evidence. Single transmitter without ACK repeats frames; model must not certify delivery from configured bitrate.

after.label: Actual main line length
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual line length unknown and nonnegative. CiA theoretical40m at1M is not a universal validated installation limit; real cables/transceivers/sample point reduce allowable length. No automatic length derived from bitrate.

after.label: Actual CAN clock
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual CAN controller clock unknown in Hz, not CPU clock or universal8MHz. Complete actual functional timing tuple must satisfy bitrate=clock/[prescaler*(1+TSEG1+TSEG2)]. M_CAN reset500k at8MHz is an example, not a generic CAN rate default.

after.label: Actual bit timing controller profile
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual controller family unknown. M_CAN_3_3_1 explicit choice activates only that manual's prescaler/segment limits. DEVICE_SPECIFIC never inherits M_CAN register maxima or historical Bosch2.0 legacy segment maxima.

after.label: Actual data length / requested remote length
after.description: CAN Data field contains four header bytes plus 0..4 CANaerospace body bytes.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual lower CAN Data field length4..8 for this registered standard-header baseline; exact body+4. Not the body length or a remote-request length.

after.label: Observed controller error state
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Observed ERROR_ACTIVE/ERROR_PASSIVE/BUS_OFF unknown, not default healthy. Active counters<=127; passive TX<256; bus-off TX>=256. Both observed counters<=127 contradict passive state. Counter dynamics, ACK exceptions/recovery sequence are not implemented by static validation.

after.label: Actual CAN identifier format
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual IDE choice BASE_11/EXTENDED_29 unknown. Both formats may coexist; actual per-message field, not an industry default. Capacity bound uses longer format if IDE unknown, and never confirms an inferred identifier.

after.label: CAN frame baseline
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Only DATA applies to the registered standard-header CANaerospace message transport; CAN REMOTE request is not a CANaerospace service message.

after.label: Actual identifier / wire priority
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual unsigned CAN identifier unknown, not an arbitrary default priority3. BASE_11 <=2047, EXTENDED_29 <=536870911; actual collision-free assignment and base/SRR/RTR arbitration scheduling require separate verification.

after.label: Registered CAN CC physical baseline
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Registered profile explicitly declares ISO11898-2 high-speed twisted pair baseline. Other physical layers exist and require a separate explicit profile; does not silently compare HS against fault-tolerant125k/single-wire/truck-trailer limits.

after.label: Actual prescaler (functional value)
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual positive integer functional prescaler unknown, not zero-based hardware register. M_CAN3.3.1 allows1..512; other controllers require own datasheet limits. No universal default or maximum512 imposed without that explicit controller profile.

after.label: Observed receive error counter
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual observed nonnegative integer receive error counter unknown; error-active requires<=127. Controller reset/reception transition behavior must use actual implementation evidence.

after.label: Actual resynchronization jump width
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual functional resynchronization jump unknown, positive integer <=actual TSEG1 and TSEG2. Explicit M_CAN3.3.1 <=128; hardware zero-based register encoding is not entered as functional zero.

after.label: Actual longest stub
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual longest stub unknown; no CANopen rate-specific table silently reused as universal CC. Topology/propagation/electrical loading need actual line evidence.

after.label: HS line termination recommendation
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: CiA HS line topology recommendation120 Ohm at each end proposed; actual impedance/split termination and placement require wiring verification. Positive numeric input is configuration, not proof of ISO electrical conformance.

after.label: Actual Prop_Seg + Phase_Seg1 (functional value)
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual functional Prop_Seg+Phase_Seg1 unknown. M_CAN3.3.1 functional2..256 only for explicit controller; not historical1..8 segments copied into every controller. Together with SYNC1 and TSEG2 defines bit period and sample point.

after.label: Actual Phase_Seg2 (functional value)
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual functional Phase_Seg2 unknown. M_CAN3.3.1 functional2..128 only when selected. Actual oscillator/propagation/sample-point tolerances still require hardware and topology evidence.

after.label: Observed transmit error counter
after.description: Declared CAN CC configuration, not proof of actual controller state, hardware conformance or bounded retransmissions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual observed nonnegative integer transmit error counter unknown, not injected bit-error probability. No invented controller counter width; profile verifies known state thresholds but does not prove current fault-confinement execution.

after.label: Actual identifier before redundancy offset
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual base identifier before redundancy offset unknown. Standard distribution class ranges0..127/128..199/200..299/300..1799/1800..1899/1900..1999/2000..2031. No parameter name inferred from an ID alone. Custom schemes beyond registered baseline need extension.

after.label: Standard message encoding
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Standard body uses BIG_ENDIAN encoding, fixed proposal. Actual host CPU endianness must not change wire encoding. Signed values/raw service octets require explicit encoding.

after.label: Actual datatype code
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual datatype code unknown. Standard0..31 map exact body lengths; reserved32..99 rejected. User-defined100..255 requires actual explicit encoding and is not automatically interpreted. DOUBLEH/DOUBLEL each4 bytes, not one8-byte CANaerospace body.

after.label: Identifier distribution baseline
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Recommended standard distribution code0 proposed; reserved1..99 rejected, user-defined100..255 explicit and unmodeled. No implicit identification response confirming actual peer scheme or custom encoding.

after.label: Registered standard header code
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Standard four-byte header identification code0 proposed. Other actual header types require an explicit extension; never pretend their lengths or encoding match standard0.

after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual mandatory IDS-on-channel0 capability unknown; explicitly false cannot conform to registered baseline. Mandatory protocol requirement never automatically becomes confirmed device support.

after.label: Actual message class
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual message class EED/NSH/UDH/NOD/UDL/DSD/NSL unknown. Explicit standard distribution0 activates own base-ID class ranges; class is not automotive device type.

after.label: Actual message/sequence code octet
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual sequence/service extension octet0..255 unknown. NOD increments modulo256; NSH/NSL uses service extension semantics. No invented initial/current sequence or proof of live monitoring from static validation.

after.label: Actual NOD service code use
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual NOD use unknown boolean; known false requires service code0. Not a checkbox silently set false and confirmed.

after.label: Actual sender or addressed node; zero broadcast
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual encoded header Node-ID octet0..255 unknown. Zero broadcasts to all nodes; EED/NOD header identifies sender whereas NSH/NSL identifies addressed station. NIS node-ID service1..199 range is not indiscriminately imposed on every octet.

after.label: Redundancy level baseline
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Unredundant baseline0 proposed; nonzero requires extended29-bit CAN identifier and actual identifier=base+65536*level. Level integer0..8191 from29-bit identifier range, not a default redundant architecture or safety guarantee.

after.label: Actual node service response bound
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual service response time bound unknown, nonnegative<=100ms for requests requiring response. Neither standard deadline nor configured bitrate proves this actual bound.

after.label: Node service response deadline
after.description: CANaerospace1.7 standard header baseline. Actual node/message/service state remains unconfirmed; custom headers/distributions require explicit extensions.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Standard100-ms response deadline proposal for requests requiring a response. Connectionless/BSS successful no-response services do not acquire a fake response transaction.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Declared specification1.7 baseline2006-01-12. Later drafts/ARINC825 adaptations are not claimed as verified by this specific profile.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual high-priority channel0..35 or low-priority100..115 unknown. For standard services high requestID128+2*channel, response+1; low request1800+2*channel,response+1. Mandatory IDS channel0 support does not automatically configure every service on channel0.

after.label: Actual encoded service code octet

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual encoded header octet0..255 unknown. Negative service response codes need signed-to-octet encoding, not generic negative raw byte input.

after.label: Retransmission

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Automatic retransmission is the CAN CC protocol baseline, proposed true only; false is invalid for this declared baseline. One-shot hardware modes need separate actual-controller behavior. No finite retry count or error-free operation is implied.
Scenario probability does not implement CAN ACK/error/fault-confinement retry behavior.
